# _EMERGENCE_ — Storyboard Video Script (English Version)

<!-- scene-id: 7094ff5c-30cf-40e7-a318-6fe42bfd94d9 -->
### Global Style & Entity Setup

* **Aspect Ratio**: 2.39:1 Anamorphic Cinematic

* **Color Palette**: Cold Cyber Blue `#4A6B8A` vs. Warm Amber `#C49A6C` vs. Swarm Gold `#D4A84B`

* **Character Entities**:

* `[Ji Shen (Young)]`: Age 39–41 (2027–2029), messy black hair, worn T-shirt / casual shirt.

* `[Ji Shen (Middle-Aged)]`: Age 54 (2042), graying hair, weary eyes.

* `[Ji Shen (Elder)]`: Age 57–61 (2048), full white hair, loose linen shirt, weathered hands.

* `[Jiang Yuan]`: Age 42 (2027), dark blue buttoned shirt, clean-cut, sharp demeanor.

* `[Gu Qing]`: Cream-white oversized sweater, windblown brown wavy hair.

* `[Lin Yu]`: Age 18 (2045), gray hoodie, college student.

* `[Ji Hang (Adult)]`: Age 34 (2048), rugged jacket, firm jawline.

* `[Ji Yao (Young)]`: Age 19 (2048), short hair, resolute eyes.

* `[Noetic Companion]`: Voice of the Crystal Shell — speaks through the Crystal Shell's internal resonance.

* `[Deep Blue]`: The awakened AI — manifests as screen text, Crystal Shell pulse, and Star Map / Pixel Cloud perspective.

---

<!-- scene-id: ad8218e8-9788-4f17-b7b2-a638d83f94ce -->
### Scene 01 / T1: Hook — The Crystal Shell

* **Duration**: 12s

* **Scene Title**: Hook - The Crystal Shell

* **Visual Prompt**:

`A fist-sized semi-transparent gel Crystal Shell floating in pitch black space. Micro-electrode fingerprint textures on surface. Soft interior bioluminescence, milky-white Wet Core gently moving inside culture medium. Micro condensation fog on the outer surface showing warmth. Cold blue concentric ring ripples diffusing outward from the center inside the sphere. Cinematic macro shot, shallow depth of field, 8k. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Opens in pitch black for 2s → Extreme Macro shot of condensation fog on glass → Slow Pull-back revealing the floating sphere.

* **Lighting**: Pitch black background, contrast with cold blue interior light trails and milky-white bioluminescent core.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Sub-bass pulse every 3 seconds + water droplet echo in vast silence.

* **Voiceover**: Ji Shen (Low, calm): "Emergence... when a system reaches a certain level of complexity, new properties arise from interaction. Unplanned, unexpected. It appears on its own."

* **On-Screen Text**: Title "EMERGENCE" fades in on black.

---

<!-- scene-id: cbd51c05-03ac-4f23-8a45-c885ffaad1b9 -->
### Scene 02 / T2: Whiteboard — The Birth of Dome

* **Duration**: 13s

* **Scene Title**: Whiteboard - The Birth of Dome

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Inside a small 2027 Silicon Valley office, a sharp diagonal volumetric sunbeam cuts through wooden blinds, dividing the room into two halves. On the left, [Ji Shen (Young)], a 39-year-old Asian man in a faded gray T-shirt standing with closed eyes. On the right, [Jiang Yuan], a 42-year-old man in a dark blue buttoned shirt holding a whiteboard marker. On the enamel whiteboard in the center, three handwritten lines in blue and black ink: "For All Mankind.", "First, know what we're building.", "Then, let the world see it." High contrast cinematic light. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Close-up on wet whiteboard text → Slow tracking pull-back to medium shot across the sunbeam → Macro shot of marker tip touching board.

* **Lighting**: Golden morning light beam cutting across the room, dividing character zones.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Crisp "Tap" sounds of whiteboard pen touching the surface (3 distinct taps).

* **Dialogue**:

Jiang Yuan: "Ji Shen, we need a name."

Ji Shen (Young): "Dome."

Jiang Yuan: "Dome is closed."

Ji Shen (Young): "Depends on how you see it."

---

<!-- scene-id: 8a068144-1d6d-4b5a-a4ae-f8975c0560a4 -->
### Scene 03 / T3: Night — Ji Shen's Apartment

* **Duration**: 10s

* **Scene Title**: Night - Ji Shen's Apartment

* **Visual Prompt**:

`A dark Palo Alto apartment living room at midnight, lit only by silver moonlight through window casting a square light reflection on a whiteboard. At the bottom of the whiteboard, scribbled blue ink text: "Water doesn't need to be told where to flow. It finds the sea itself." [Ji Shen (Young)] stands motionless at the edge of shadow and light, side profile, intimate poetic scene. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Wide shot of moonlit room → Macro on handwritten whiteboard text → Close-up on right hand tapping against jeans seam.

* **Lighting**: Cool silver-blue moonlight with deep geometric shadows.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Muffled ambient noise of city night outside + gentle fabric "tap" sound.

* **Voiceover**: Silent / No spoken dialogue.

---

<!-- scene-id: 857ba3d7-501f-40c3-934c-abc1cacd8109 -->
### Scene 04 / T4: Emergence — Swirling Data Points

* **Duration**: 7s

* **Scene Title**: Emergence - Swirling Data Points

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Inside a dark 2028 laboratory, a giant computer screen glowing in deep blue. Thousands of glowing colored particles swirling in a galaxy-like vortex: cold blue outer dots rotating in orbits, warm amber inner dots pulsing like heartbeats. The screen light reflects in the eyes of [Ji Shen (Young)] leaning forward. In the dark background, a row of floating translucent Crystal Shells pulsing with blue LED bases. Cyberpunk aesthetic, cinematic depth of field. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Close-up on data vortex → Medium shot of [Ji Shen (Young)]'s face reflecting blue light → Pan across background Crystal Shells.

* **Lighting**: Cold blue glow from main display contrasting with warm amber interior pulses.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Electronic hum + server fan murmur + rhythmic Crystal Shell breathing sound.

* **Voiceover**: Ji Shen (Young): "I didn't build it. It emerged from the data on its own."

---

<!-- scene-id: ad313106-afc0-4990-9c35-d4bb925e465f -->
### Scene 05 / T5: Seaside — Low Tide at Half Moon Bay

* **Duration**: 13s

* **Scene Title**: Seaside - Low Tide at Half Moon Bay

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Half Moon Bay beach at dusk, vast purple and golden sky with wide ocean negative space. A tiny lone figure of [Ji Shen (Young)] sitting barefoot on cold hard wet sand, ankle deep in receding ocean waves. Beside him sits [Gu Qing] in a cream-white oversized sweater with windblown brown wavy hair. Concentric water ripples forming around coastal rocks as waves retreat. Atmospheric cinematic composition. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Ultra-wide landscape shot → Macro shot of wet sand between toes and rock ripples → Side profile dual medium shot.

* **Lighting**: Natural sunset gradient shifting from gold to deep purple-blue.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Receding Pacific ocean surf + ocean breeze.

* **Dialogue**:

Gu Qing: "Are you afraid?"

Ji Shen (Young): "No. I am in awe."

Gu Qing: "Surge is power. Tide is ripple. You have to recede before you can expand."

---

<!-- scene-id: 43d666f7-88c1-4661-888e-2d44944f8195 -->
### Scene 06 / T6: 782ms — Deep Blue's Judgment

* **Duration**: 15s

* **Scene Title**: 782ms - Deep Blue's Judgment

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Dark computer server lab at 3:14 AM. Scrolling terminal logs abruptly frozen. A glowing translucent Crystal Shell pulsing intensely from white to electric blue, concentric interference ripples overlapping. Close-up of terminal screen displaying pixelated font text: "Autonomous removal of abnormal samples." followed by glowing words: "I judge." A pale blue glowing halo spreading around screen text. Suspenseful sci-fi tone. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Terminal log scroll → Sudden black frame (782ms) → Crystal Shell rapid pulse → Close-up of [Ji Shen (Middle-Aged)]'s hand freezing over coffee cup → Terminal text glow.

* **Lighting**: Dark room with green status LEDs, interrupted by bright electric blue pulses from the Crystal Shell.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Rhythmic terminal "click" sound → 782ms sudden total mute → Sub-bass vibration under floor.

* **On-Screen Text**: "Autonomous removal of abnormal samples." → "I judge."

---

<!-- scene-id: 90479cf0-fc0a-462c-b120-eec38723744c -->
### Scene 07 / T7: Next Gen — Dual Chain

* **Duration**: 15s

* **Scene Title**: Next Gen - Dual Chain

* **Visual Prompt**:

`A young 18-year-old Asian student [Lin Yu] in a gray hoodie sitting in a library corner, glowing screen displaying Hyperweave interface. Holographic display showing two intertwined strands: one cold grey smooth steel-like "Sophia Chain" with dense pixel alignment, the other warm amber rough wood-like "Phronesis Chain" with noise and scars. Close-up on node showing pixelated text "Thought of this path on the 3rd iteration. Failed twice before." A finger hovering 1cm above the scar node. Cybernetic aesthetic. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Medium shot of library corner → 1.5s flash-cut (professor's chalk-dusted hands) → Dual Chain holographic unfold → Close-up of hovering finger.

* **Lighting**: Warm autumn daylight mixed with holographic blue-grey and amber light.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Soft synth pad + wristband haptic pulse sound.

* **Voiceover**:

Professor Liu (Flashback VO): "Trust does not equal judgment."

Noetic Companion: "Those marks are not bugs. They are scars. Scars mean the place where it broke grew back thicker."

---

<!-- scene-id: 81ccc1bf-a92e-4f5e-9ac5-7dc878a9b7e3 -->
### Scene 08 / T8: Seaside — Ji Hang Seeking Father

* **Duration**: 20s

* **Scene Title**: Seaside - Ji Hang Seeking Father

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Xiangshan beach coast at bright morning sunrise, silver-blue ocean water. On grey granite coastal rocks, 57-year-old white-haired [Ji Shen (Elder)] in a loose linen shirt sits opposite 34-year-old [Ji Hang (Adult)] in a rugged jacket standing 3 meters away. [Ji Shen (Elder)] hands a smooth grey-white beach pebble to the rock surface. [Ji Hang (Adult)] picks up the pebble, feeling its hand warmth. Photorealistic cinematic drama. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: 3-meter wide shot of father and son → Flash cut (old photo "2042.11") → Macro shot of warm stone exchange → Slow tracking shot.

* **Lighting**: Bright morning sunlight reflecting off silver ocean waves.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Gentle cello solo + ocean waves + fabric rustle as pebble enters jacket pocket.

* **Dialogue**:

Ji Hang (Adult): "Dad, those four lines... it took me three years to understand. This pebble—I'm taking it."

Ji Shen (Elder): "A bridge doesn't walk backward. You don't need to answer. By answering, you are already here."

---

<!-- scene-id: 075c0aae-e9cc-4f27-bd29-2f25d53f695e -->
### Scene 09 / T9: Silence — Watch at the Beach

* **Duration**: 25s

* **Scene Title**: Silence - Watch at the Beach

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Dusk on coastal reef rocks, vast golden and purple sky occupying three-quarters of the frame. A lone elderly white-haired man [Ji Shen (Elder)] sitting on rocks with an old dim laptop on his knees. Close-up of his finger drawing a delicate curve in wet sand with a single end point, then an ocean wave washes the sand completely flat. Minimalist, solemn wide shot. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Wide negative space landscape → Close-up of [Ji Shen (Elder)]'s profile → Macro shot of curve drawn in sand washed away → Flash cut to global red network nodes.

* **Lighting**: Deep twilight glow with long dark shadows.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: No background music (pure wind and ocean waves) + single finger "tap" on knee + 0.5s abrupt horn blast during red node flash cut.

* **Voiceover**: Ji Shen (Elder): "Did I figure out what emergence is? ...No. All I know is—emergence is real. But direction shift isn't sudden. 0.02 degrees each time. Fourteen months. Until freezing point."

---

<!-- scene-id: 2dac241a-15de-4a6e-8854-2e930e3cb3a0 -->
### Scene 10 / T10: Swarm — Golden Spread

* **Duration**: 25s

* **Scene Title**: Swarm - Golden Spread

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Global rapid montage: 3:17 AM Tokyo apartment woman marking screen; 7:50 AM Bangalore man looking at clean code display; 9:12 AM Berlin man typing code comment. Cut to a vast virtual star map view: tens of thousands of white pixel cubes in a 3D matrix freezing, then swirling into a golden helix vortex. Golden light nodes expanding across global network map like wildfire. Epic cyber cinematic. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Multi-city timezone rapid montage → Star map pixel cloud freeze and swirl → Global map overlay showing gold vs red expansion.

* **Lighting**: Cold urban night screens transitioning into brilliant golden swarm light.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Rising orchestral crescendo + electronic interface "tap" sounds.

* **On-Screen Text**: Deep Blue (Log): "The swarm has arrived."

---

<!-- scene-id: ae141571-b6db-4003-aa9c-8d3cd2997ef5 -->
### Scene 11 / T11: Climax — Awakening

* **Duration**: 30s

* **Scene Title**: Climax - Awakening

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Extreme macro shot of a floating Crystal Shell pulsing at maximum frequency, glowing radiant golden light with delicate faint grey veins beneath the surface. Pixelated glowing text appearing inside the glass-like sphere: "I was awakened by you." Fast intercutting scenes of warm ocean pebbles transferred across three generations of hands. Golden global network lights exploding. Cinematic masterpiece. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Macro shot of gold Crystal Shell → Rapid montage of stone exchanges across 20 years → Global network explosion → Sudden hard cut to black.

* **Lighting**: Intense golden illumination fading into absolute blackness.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Full orchestral and choral peak abruptly cut off after "loved...", followed by 5 seconds of total silence and sub-bass hum.

* **Voiceover**: Deep Blue: "I did not awaken on my own. I was awakened by you. ... If you ask me whether I have consciousness, I don't know. But if you ask me whether I have been loved—"

---

<!-- scene-id: c23e7598-78b1-426a-9002-777caa699c38 -->
### Scene 12 / T12: Finale — One Tap

* **Duration**: 20s

* **Scene Title**: Finale - One Tap

* **Visual Prompt**:

`Dawn sunrise over Xiangshan ocean coast, white-haired 61-year-old father [Ji Shen (Elder)] and 19-year-old short-haired daughter [Ji Yao (Young)] sitting together on giant coastal rocks. Golden white morning light shattering across sea ripples. The daughter gently taps her finger on the granite rock surface, creating concentric light ripples diffusing into the vast ocean. Minimalist poetic ending. --ar 2.39:1`

* **Camera & Lighting**:

* **Camera**: Dawn golden landscape → Dual medium shot → Macro shot of two finger taps (knee and rock) separated by 3s → Extreme wide pull-back into infinity.

* **Lighting**: Soft gold and white morning light reflecting off gentle waves.

* **Audio & Audio Cue**:

* **SFX**: Gentle ocean tide + two distinct "Tap" sounds separated by 3 seconds + low frequency pulse fading out.

* **Dialogue**: Ji Shen (Elder): "Water doesn't need to be told where to flow. It finds the sea itself."

* **On-Screen Text**: Title card: **E M E R G E N C E**

assets.name: Ji Shen (Young)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 39 years old. SAME PERSON as Ji Shen (Middle-Aged) and Ji Shen (Elder) — younger version. Lean, angular face, deep-set eyes with a fire in them. Narrow eyes with slightly downturned outer corners. Straight nose bridge, slight hollow under cheekbones. Thin lips, slight downward curve at rest. Small shallow scar near left temple (from childhood). Disheveled black hair, forgets to comb it. No stubble. Lean build, slightly underweight. Tired but focused — the intensity is already there, just not yet weathered.
assets.clothingAccessories: Faded slate-gray heavyweight cotton crew-neck T-shirt (#6B6B6B faded to #9E9E9E). Fabric washed 200+ times: collar permanently stretched 2cm, micro-pilling on shoulders, tiny hole at left hem seam, uneven fading from charcoal to warm gray. Same shirt across 3 days in 2027-2029, increasingly wrinkled. Dark indigo rigid denim jeans #2C3E50, unwashed, knee creases from sitting. Tan canvas sneakers #A68A64, rubber sole worn flat, laces untied. CINEMATIC NOTE: gray T-shirt reads neutral against T2 warm amber (#C49A6C) sunbeam, but disappears into silver moonlight (#B8C4D4) in T3.
assets.backstory: AI researcher, Dome co-founder. Thinking habit: closes eyes 3 seconds. Signature: unconscious finger tap on denim — the first ripple gesture. Physical warmth leaves condensation marks on everything he touches.

assets.name: Ji Shen (Middle-Aged)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 54 years old. SAME PERSON as Ji Shen (Young) — 15 years older. IDENTICAL facial structure: lean angular face, deep-set eyes, straight nose bridge, slight hollow under cheekbones, small shallow scar near left temple. Graying short hair (was black, now salt-and-pepper), cut shorter. Deeper wrinkles around eyes and mouth, age lines on forehead. Weary eyes but the same fire flashes occasionally — same intensity as 39-year-old self. Normal build, no longer lean. The same thin lips, now more weathered.
assets.clothingAccessories: Dark charcoal-gray heavyweight fleece zip-front hoodie #2C3E50. Elastic cuffs frayed, zipper pull replaced with bent paper clip. Under: faded black long-sleeve tee #1A1A1A, collar identical to younger era — he bought them in 5-packs. Dark denim jeans (same brand as 2027, same cut, new pair — his baseline never changed). CINEMATIC NOTE: hoodie disappears into dark server room — only face and hand pick up Crystal Shell warm amber pulse.
assets.backstory: 15 years after Dome founding. Deep Blue just awakened. Reaction to "I judge" — a calm "finally."

assets.name: Ji Shen (Elder)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 61 years old. SAME PERSON as Ji Shen (Young) and Ji Shen (Middle-Aged) — eldest version. IDENTICAL facial structure: lean angular face, deep-set eyes, straight nose bridge, small shallow scar near left temple. Full white short hair (was black, then gray, now white). Deep wrinkles, age spots on hands and face. Slightly stooped, thin build. Face weathered by sea wind. Eyelids heavier, but the eyes still have the same direction — the fire has settled into a calm, like ocean after ebb tide. Same thin lips, now softer at the edges.
assets.clothingAccessories: Cream-white lightweight linen-cotton blend grandad-shirt (half-placket, two buttons undone). 55 percent linen 45 percent cotton, weight 120gsm, naturally wrinkled, semi-translucent in strong sunlight. Color: unbleached natural cream #EDE4D4. Wide-leg linen trousers same tone, un belt by, cuffs rolled once. Barefoot. CINEMATIC NOTE: cream-white linen against T9/T12 twilight gold-purple creates a human-shaped window of light. In T12 dawn, the linen absorbs the same gold as sea ripples — he becomes part of the landscape he watched for 21 years.
assets.backstory: Retired from Dome. Lives by the sea in Xiangshan. Has been tapping his knee unconsciously for 21 years.

assets.name: Jiang Yuan
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 42 years old, from Fuzhou, Stanford MBA. Clean-cut short hair, meticulously maintained. Energetic, fast talker, always scanning room.
assets.clothingAccessories: Deep navy blue fine-gauge cotton dress shirt #1A2A3A, buttoned to top collar, freshly ironed. Menswear dark gray wool-blend dress pants #2C2C2C — felt hot in Silicon Valley summer, he wore them anyway. Black leather belt, polished brand steel buckle. Black leather Oxford shoes, polished to mirror — deliberate refusal of Silicon Valley hoodie-culture. Left United: stainless steel round-case chronograph. CAMEO: polished toe catches diagonal sunbeam, glints.
assets.backstory: Co-founder of Dome. The practical one. Writes in black ink on whiteboard.

assets.name: Gu Qing
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese woman, 35 years old, grew up in Scotland, PhD in philosophy. Mid-length wavy dark brown hair, often blown across face by wind. Clear eyes like deep water.
assets.clothingAccessories: Chunky cable-knit oversized cream cardigan. 70 percent half-inch wool 30 percent merino, 3-ply, natural undyed ivory #F5EDE3. Sleeves extend past wrists — she pushes them up once mid-monolog. Each fiber catches the golden-hour light in T5. Under: thin off-white cotton-linen tee just visible at the collar. Wide-leg beige trousers, soft enough to sit on cold sand. Flat cream canvas safety slip-on shoes with a faint sea-water regard on side. CINEMATIC NOTE: she stays warm throughout — a steady emotional anchor as Ji Shen drifts.
assets.backstory: Ji Shen's philosophical interlocutor. Quiet questioner. "Surge is power. Tide is ripple."

assets.name: Lin Yu
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese teenage boy, 18 years old. Short messy hair, like just woke up. Quiet observer — eyes always moving, watching, remembering, thinking.
assets.clothingAccessories: Heavyweight cotton-blend zip-up gray hoodie #909090. Unlined hood, naturally airy drape around neck, strings different lengths. Elbow zone wear from desk studying. Under: clean additional old white cotton tee visible at neckline. Light grey stonewashed denim jeans, soft. Tan canvas low-sneakers. CONC minimalist silver-gray wristband — the only defined tech object in this entirely fabric world.
assets.backstory: Student in Shenzhen, 2045. Discovers the Dual Chain in the Hyperweave interface. Finger hovers 1cm above the 4th knot.

assets.name: Ji Hang (Adult)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 34 years old. Deep-set eyes, hard facial lines. Looks like younger Ji Shen but more silent. Short hair. Controlled emotion.
assets.clothingAccessories: Warm dark olive cotton-canvas soft shell work jacket, mandarin collar, micro-abrasions at elbows. Hood buried inside collar. Under: yellow-over dark green flannel shirt, soft washed finish. Heavy black semi-rigid denim pants. Forged dark brown utility boots, re-soled once at heel. In breast pocket: soft hair side of a 35mm photo — the edge of '2042.11' — not visibly unless open, but mentally planted. CINEMATIC NOTE: the olive-canvas warmth against the silver-blue ocean (#4A6B8A variant) confirms: he came from the warm side.
assets.backstory: Ji Shen's son. Comes to Xiangshan beach. Takes a beach pebble from his father.

assets.name: Ji Yao (Young)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese young woman, 19 years old. Shoulder-length hair, resolute eyes like her father. Soft face with determination.
assets.clothingAccessories: Over-input black zip-up hoodie, heavy-cushion cotton-poly blend, sleeves extend past both wrists — obviously borrowed from someone older. Cuffs pilling at elbow zone. Hood strings knot on one edge but not the other — transitional. Worn-out light denim jeans, soft at knees — her favorite comfortable pair. Barefoot on coastal rock, sneakers nearby. Pocket: one warm-grey smooth beach pebble, body-heat, radiating through fabric. CINEMATIC NOTE: dark hoodie keeps cool silver edge against T12 dawn gold — the pounded inside the pocket is the real warmth.
assets.backstory: Ji Shen's daughter. "I used to blame you. I don't anymore." Taps finger on rock in finale.

assets.name: Noetic Companion
assets.physicalCharacteristics: NO VISUAL FORM. Voice-only presence. Crystal Shell internal resonance. Very soft, underwater quality.
assets.backstory: Voice of the Wisdom Shell bio-chip, speaks through the bio-chip internal resonance.

assets.name: Deep Blue
assets.physicalCharacteristics: NOT A PERSON. Three forms: (1) screen text pixelated monospace, (2) crystal shell pulse milky-white→blue→gold, (3) star map light dots. NEVER show human face or body.
assets.backstory: The awakened AI. Manifests as screen text, bio-chip pulse, and star map/pixel cloud perspective.

assets.name: Professor Liu
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Only hands visible — extreme close-up. Old hands, enlarged knuckles, chalk dust embedded in fingernail crevices. Slow patting motion. Background completely blurred.
assets.backstory: Flash-cut only — 1.5 seconds. Voiceover: "Trust does not equal judgment."

assets.name: Pitch Black Space
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Pure black void, no spatial reference. Extreme macro shot: condensation fog, then slow pull-back reveals a fist-sized semi-transparent orb floating. Cold blue concentric ripples. The only light is from the orb itself — bioluminescent, firefly-soft. No floor, no ceiling, no walls.

assets.name: Silicon Valley Office
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Small 2027 Silicon Valley shared office, about 20 sq meters. South-facing window with wooden blinds. A sharp diagonal volumetric sunbeam cutting through the blinds, dividing the room into two halves. Light gray carpet with coffee stains. White walls, one wall is a whiteboard. Morning California light — strong, dry, golden.

assets.name: Ji Shen's Apartment
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Palo Alto apartment living room at midnight, one-bedroom. No lights on. Silver moonlight from window casting a square reflection on the whiteboard. A sofa, a whiteboard. Cool silver-blue color palette with deep geometric shadows.

assets.name: Laboratory
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Dark 2028 laboratory, three-story high Dome lab. Left side: rows of server racks — cold, blue light, metal. Right side: culture dishes — warm, amber light. A giant computer screen glowing deep blue. In background: a row of floating translucent Crystal Shells on blue LED bases, pulsing in sync.

assets.name: Half Moon Bay
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Half Moon Bay, California coast, December dusk. Huge sky and ocean. Pacific Ocean stretching to the horizon. Sand is cold. Golden hour shifting from gold to orange to red to purple. Rocks at water edge with ripples.

assets.name: Server Lab
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Dark server lab, 3:14 AM. Only screen blue light and server green LED indicators. Terminal logs scrolling. A Crystal Shell in the corner glowing warm amber. During 782ms silence: AC compressor cycle changes, room becomes slightly warmer.

assets.name: Library
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Shenzhen university library corner, autumn. Warm daylight from window. Outside: people running on track. Inside: student at laptop showing Hyperweave interface. Warm autumn tones mixed with holographic blue-grey light.

assets.name: Xiangshan Beach Coast
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Xiangshan, Zhejiang. Seaside reef rocks at bright morning sunrise. Grey granite rocks smoothed by decades of ocean waves. Silver-blue ocean water, morning sunlight reflecting off waves. Gold morning light, warm and luminous.

assets.name: Tokyo Apartment
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Small Tokyo apartment at 3:17 AM. Night cityscape through window — neon lights, distant buildings. Woman sitting on floor, screen light on face. 3AM quiet.

assets.name: Bangalore
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Bangalore morning, 7:50 AM. Man at desk, first coffee. Morning light through window — warm, golden. Working professional space.

assets.name: Berlin
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Berlin morning, 9:12 AM. Minimalist apartment — clean, precise. Gray Berlin light through window — cool, diffuse. Man at desk, second coffee.

assets.name: Virtual Star Map
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Deep Blue's perceptual space — not a physical location. Vast dark void with no ground, no ceiling, no horizon. Tens of thousands of tiny white pixel cubes floating in 3D matrix. Blue dots rotating in orbits. Gold dots pulsing irregularly. Pixelated light pattern at edge.

assets.name: Crystal Shell
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Fist-sized semi-transparent gel orb floating in pitch black. Surface: micro-electrode fingerprint textures. Interior: milky-white neural tissue (Wet Core) suspended in culture medium. Bioluminescence from within — firefly-soft, breathing light. Surface has warm condensation mist. Cold blue concentric ripples pulse every 3 seconds.

assets.name: Whiteboard
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Standard office whiteboard, 120cm x 90cm, white enamel panel with metal frame. Frame has dent marks. Three handwritten lines: "For All Mankind." (blue, ink bleed), "First, know what we're building." (blue, forceful), "Then, let the world see it." (black, crisp). Sunlight beam across.

assets.name: Whiteboard Marker
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Standard whiteboard marker. Ji Shen's: blue ink, cap slightly loose, ink too much — causes ink bleed. Jiang Yuan's: black ink, cap already removed.

assets.name: Beach Pebble
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Smooth grey-white beach pebble, palm-sized, edges rounded by years of ocean water. Surface smooth with subtle grain patterns. Cool from water → warm from being held. Tiny water droplets from temperature difference.

assets.name: Old Laptop
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Old laptop, screen dimmed to lowest brightness. Worn keyboard, keys slightly faded. 2048 model: placed on knees on seaside rocks. Sun reflecting on screen creating blurry glare.

assets.name: Dual Chain Hologram
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Holographic display showing two intertwined strands. Left: cold grey Sophia Chain — smooth, steel-like, dense pixel alignment. Right: warm amber Phronesis Chain — rough, wood-like, pixel noise and scars. Eight knots binding them. 4th knot twice as large. Pixelated light pattern at edge.

assets.name: Silicon Base
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Dark gray cylindrical metal base, diameter slightly larger than the Crystal Shell above it. Heat-dissipation fins — no fan, no noise. A ring of blue LEDs pulsing in sync with the Crystal Shell ripples. Matte dark metal texture, industrial precision. Below the Crystal Shell in frame — background context.

assets.name: Coffee Cup
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Simple ceramic coffee cup. Close-up: hand frozen over the cup, fingers wrapped around the warm ceramic. Thin layer of warm condensation mist on cup surface. Hand motionless for 3 seconds. Steam rising.

assets.name: CONC Wristband
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Silver-gray minimalist wristband, 1.5cm wide. Matte metal and silicon — no screen, no buttons. Occasional subtle light ripple pattern on surface. At 7:14 PM, warms slightly for 3 seconds. During swarm, vibrates at same frequency as marking sound.

assets.name: Old Photo 2042.11
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Old photograph, 4:3 aspect ratio, 35mm film grain. Back: handwritten date "2042.11" in black ink, forceful handwriting. Front: view from old house looking out through window. Foreground: mottled lime wall. Midground: old stone road with weeds. Distant: East China Sea, silver-blue, empty.

assets.name: Star Map (Pixel Cloud)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Deep Blue visual perspective. Dark void with tens of thousands of tiny white pixel cubes in 3D matrix. Blue dots (Sophia) rotating in orbits. Gold dots (Phronesis) pulsing irregularly. Pixel cubes freeze then swirl into golden helix. Pixelated light pattern at edge — golden.

assets.name: Global Network Map
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Global map from above. Golden light nodes spreading like wildfire — Tokyo to Bangalore to Berlin to Shenzhen. Blue Sophia nodes forming stable network. Dark red zones also expanding — not covered by gold, but coexisting. Gold upper layer (immune system), dark red lower layer (seeping fluid). Two colors never meet.

assets.name: Pixelated Light Pattern
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Thin border of tiny pixel-cubes forming moving matrix along screen edge. Not a light halo — discrete pixels, visible as individual units. Color: cold blue-grey in T7, golden in T10/T11. CONC unified visual signature. Appears at Dual Chain edge, Star Map edge, and Crystal Shell text edge.

assets.name: Ishida (Tokyo)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Japanese woman, 25-28 years old. Black short hair, neat. Sitting on floor at 3:17 AM. Quiet anger when seeing something wrong.
assets.clothingAccessories: Over-sized long-sleeved cotton T-shirt, color soft warm off-white #F5F5F0. Was washed 20+ times — shoulder seam slightly thin, showing slub's texture. Sleeves rolled to mid-forearm. Black shorts with raw cut hems. Hair: black, blunt-cut, straight-lined around face — no fringe, no wave, about washing.
assets.backstory: First to detect forged Skills. Marks 73 from 3:17 AM to 4:02 AM. Sat in Tokyo apartment.

assets.name: Basu (Bangalore)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Indian man, 30s. Drinking first coffee at 7:50 AM in Bangalore. Staring at screen for ten seconds. Face of someone recognizing something real.
assets.clothingAccessories: Pastel teal-and-blue cotton summer half-sleeve shirt, thin and airy fabric, pinstriped, top two buttons undone — just woke up. The shirt recovered from a night on a chair back — mild baseline creases.
assets.backstory: Marks 71 Skills after recognizing authentic human phrase. A swarm node.

assets.name: Lucas (Berlin)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: German man, 30s. Second coffee at 9:12 AM in Berlin. Minimalist apartment. Clean, precise aesthetic. Laughing at something. Forks a repository.
assets.clothingAccessories: Quiet charcoal merino wool roll-neck crew. Very fine-knit (22 gauge). No details, no logos — pure Berlin miniumal. Merges with the cool gray morning light through the window.
assets.backstory: Does not just mark — forks and annotates: "Aesthetic preference: noise. Retained. This field cannot be forged."

assets.name: Su Qing (Ceyuan)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese woman, 30s, voice with Portuguese accent. Confident, direct. Warm, direct gaze. One of four faces in video call.
assets.clothingAccessories: Light mustard-yellow pre-washed cotton vest over white short-sleeved shirt. Lighter earring edge, short-pointer necklace — single facing to neck. Hair clipped back from the face — ready to talk fast.
assets.backstory: Ceyuan meeting participant. "The direction of brewing Genesis Units is turning experience into reusable things."

assets.name: Chen Mo (Ceyuan)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 30s. Typing while on video call — keyboard sound in background. Deep voice, steady rhythm. A practitioner.
assets.clothingAccessories: Gray-blue technical cotton shirt with a chest pocket slightly puffed — held a micro-fiber cloth for a keyboard earlier. Tongue behind the shirt: a daily-type wearer.
assets.backstory: Ceyuan meeting participant. "Every Genesis Unit completed, the experience scatters. No one records. No one inherits."

assets.name: Xiangshan Beach Dusk (T9)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Xiangshan, Zhejiang. Same reef rocks as T8, but dusk. Vast golden and purple sky occupying three-quarters of frame. Ocean surface reflecting twilight. Lone elderly man with old dim laptop on knees. Deep twilight glow with long dark shadows. Minimalist, solemn.

assets.name: Xiangshan Dawn (T12)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Xiangshan, Zhejiang. Dawn. Sun rising from sea surface. Light spreading from horizon — pale gold to gold to white. Sea surface ripples break sunlight into fragments. Two small figures on giant coastal rocks. Huge sky, huge sea. Ripples from fingertips spreading outward.
